component.name: Canopy
component.summary: A fast, beautiful, Linux-first Git client

description.p: Canopy is a native desktop Git client. It shows your history as a coloured commit graph, lets you stage files and individual hunks, and covers everyday branch, tag, stash and remote work without leaving the keyboard.

ul.li: Commit graph with branch lanes, ref labels, avatars and search
Staging area with file and hunk staging and a commit composer with amend
Branches, tags, stashes, cherry-pick, revert, reset, merge and rebase
Fetch, pull and push through your own git configuration and credentials
Command palette, keyboard shortcuts, dark and light themes

description.p: First release: commit graph, staging and committing, branches, tags, stashes, remotes, command palette, and dark and light themes.
